title: Fix Selection Bounds Alignment
description: Correct 3D selection AABB to use same anchor as ScenePiece (plane origin). Increase diagram overlay padding to match selected circle + stroke extent.
summary: Fixed the Flatten story's diff and output windows by correcting the AlgorithmContextValue wiring. The root cause was that `design` and `diffDesign` were both set to `baseDesign` (the flattened result) instead of `rawDesign` (the original design). This caused: 1) The diff window to show no changes because it was diffing the flattened design against itself, 2) The output window to show the same as the diff. Fix: set `design: rawDesign` (so DESIGN_INPUT shows the original hierarchical design) and `diffDesign: rawDesign` (so DESIGN_DIFF_OUTPUT correctly shows all connections removed and all connected pieces modified against the original). `outputDesign` remains `baseDesign` (the flattened result with no connections). All 230 tests pass, Storybook builds successfully.
